name: csharp
description: C# for Unity and UPM packages: a Solution Explorer, the assembly graph, an Inspector for .asmdef and package.json, Unity's compile errors in Problems, .meta and GUID tools, script templates and Unity message completion, with csharp-ls.

server.install: Install the .NET 10 SDK, then dotnet tool install -g csharp-ls, then restart BMEditor

settings.label: Unity Editor.log
settings.description: Where Unity writes its log, whose compile errors go to Problems. Empty: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Unity\Editor\Editor.log on Windows.

settings.label: Solution
settings.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj the Solution Explorer and the language server open. Empty: the one in the folder, the one named like the folder first.

settings.label: Show Unity's generated files in the Explorer
settings.description: Unity writes a .csproj per assembly, the .sln and a .meta per asset. Like Visual Studio, the Explorer leaves them out; the Solution Explorer shows the projects either way.

settings.label: Write .meta files for new scripts
settings.description: New Script also writes the script's .meta in a folder Unity imports, so it is right in version control before Unity sees it.

projectKinds.label: C#
projectKinds.title: C# console app
projectKinds.text: A .csproj and a Program.cs; a folder with a .sln or .csproj opens as this kind too.

projectKinds.label: Unity Package
projectKinds.title: Unity package (UPM)
projectKinds.text: A package.json, Runtime and Editor assemblies, tests and a sample.
